translations.web: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied: yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: People staggered from city to city for water to drink, but they were not satisfied; yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: So two or three cities wandered unto one city to drink water, and were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
